title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Bru Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Bru Ice delivers a bold fusion of citrus and spice with a crisp, icy finish. This unique e-liquid blends the zesty notes of Orange with a subtle herbal undertone, capturing the familiar taste of a classic fizzy drink. A wave of coolness on the exhale rounds out the flavour, leaving a refreshing sensation. Formulated for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides rapid nicotine relief with a consistently satisfying throat hit. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio enhances flavour clarity while keeping vapour production discreet, making it ideal for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids offer a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, allowing you to enjoy familiar and satisfying flavours in a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
